title: Wisquosucks (Squassucks Point)
summary: Wisquosucks is a Brookhaven placename for Squassucks Point on the Carmans River, associated with an Unkechaug person recorded in deeds and leases.
introduction_content: Wisquosucks is a point of land on the Connecticut River, now the Carmans River, in Brookhaven town. The name was later abbreviated as Squassucks and appears in forms including Wesquasesac, Wisguassuck, Wesquasuks, and Wisquoriake.
history_content: The placename is personal as well as geographic, tied to an Unkechaug man who resided on the point and appears in late seventeenth-century deeds and leases.
translation_content:
The name is treated as that of an Unkechaug owner or dweller rather than as a separate landscape translation.

Why Place Names Matter

“Placenames are among the most enduring records of a nation’s history. Understanding them helps us understand who we are and where we come from.”

— Australian National Placenames Survey, Australian National Placenames Survey (2026), homepage, National Research Initiative section
preservation_content: Squassucks Point remains connected to the Unkechaug person and deed tradition behind the name, with the modern map point marked as approximate.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate blue/general placement at Squassucks Point on the Carmans River in Brookhaven. Coordinates are approximate and not exact historic deed boundaries.
